info.name: RF-Dialpad Cold Call Testing
info.description:
Test the /test/coldcall endpoint with real and mock payloads.

Set the `token` variable to your RF_WEBHOOK_SECRET before running.

request.description:
Real call_id from Sam Nguyen's cold call on Feb 26. State is call_transcription so the worker fetches the actual transcript from Dialpad API, then classifies it.

Will create a real RF activity on candidate 48635 if classified as cold call.

Mock voicemail with inline transcription_text. State is 'transcription' so no Dialpad API call needed — transcript comes from the payload.

Uses a fake call_id to avoid dedup conflicts. Will create a real RF activity on candidate 48658 (Klaus Berger) if classified as cold call.

item.name: Dry Run — No RF Update (fake contact ID)

request.description:
Safe dry run — contact ID has no RF UID so it will hit the deferred path (store in KV by phone number). No RF candidate will be updated.

Useful for testing the pipeline without side effects.
